catalog_change_log_update_has_both.name: catalog_change_log_update_has_both
catalog_change_log_update_has_both.value: "catalog_change_log"."operation" NOT IN ('updated','archived','restored') OR ("catalog_change_log"."before" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog_change_log"."after" IS NOT NULL)

deliveries_destination_kind_consistent.name: deliveries_destination_kind_consistent
deliveries_destination_kind_consistent.value:
(
        ("deliveries"."destination_kind" = 'location' AND "deliveries"."destination_location_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("deliveries"."destination_kind" = 'external' AND "deliveries"."destination_location_id" IS NULL AND "deliveries"."destination_snapshot" IS NOT NULL)
      )

deliveries_assigned_state_consistent.name: deliveries_assigned_state_consistent
deliveries_assigned_state_consistent.value: "deliveries"."status" NOT IN ('assigned', 'in_transit', 'completed') OR ("deliveries"."assigned_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "deliveries"."assigned_at" IS NOT NULL AND "deliveries"."assigned_by" IS NOT NULL)

deliveries_in_transit_state_consistent.name: deliveries_in_transit_state_consistent
deliveries_in_transit_state_consistent.value: "deliveries"."status" NOT IN ('in_transit', 'completed') OR ("deliveries"."dispatched_at" IS NOT NULL AND "deliveries"."dispatched_by" IS NOT NULL)

deliveries_completed_state_consistent.name: deliveries_completed_state_consistent
deliveries_completed_state_consistent.value: "deliveries"."status" <> 'completed' OR ("deliveries"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "deliveries"."completed_by" IS NOT NULL)

deliveries_cancelled_state_consistent.name: deliveries_cancelled_state_consistent
deliveries_cancelled_state_consistent.value: "deliveries"."status" <> 'cancelled' OR ("deliveries"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "deliveries"."cancelled_by" IS NOT NULL)

manual_invoice_requests_pending_state_cl.name: manual_invoice_requests_pending_state_clean
manual_invoice_requests_pending_state_cl.value: "manual_invoice_requests"."status" <> 'pending' or ("manual_invoice_requests"."approved_by" is null and "manual_invoice_requests"."approved_at" is null and "manual_invoice_requests"."approved_invoice_id" is null and "manual_invoice_requests"."rejected_by" is null and "manual_invoice_requests"."rejected_at" is null and "manual_invoice_requests"."rejection_reason" is null)

manual_invoice_requests_approved_state_c.name: manual_invoice_requests_approved_state_complete
manual_invoice_requests_approved_state_c.value: "manual_invoice_requests"."status" <> 'approved' or ("manual_invoice_requests"."approved_by" is not null and "manual_invoice_requests"."approved_at" is not null and "manual_invoice_requests"."approved_invoice_id" is not null)

manual_invoice_requests_rejected_state_c.name: manual_invoice_requests_rejected_state_complete
manual_invoice_requests_rejected_state_c.value: "manual_invoice_requests"."status" <> 'rejected' or ("manual_invoice_requests"."rejected_by" is not null and "manual_invoice_requests"."rejected_at" is not null and "manual_invoice_requests"."rejection_reason" is not null)

platform_event_audiences_shape_check.name: platform_event_audiences_shape_check
platform_event_audiences_shape_check.value:
(
        "platform_event_audiences"."audience_kind" = 'user'
        and "platform_event_audiences"."user_id" is not null
        and "platform_event_audiences"."permission_key" is null
      ) or (
        "platform_event_audiences"."audience_kind" = 'permission'
        and "platform_event_audiences"."user_id" is null
        and "platform_event_audiences"."permission_key" is not null
      )

user_notifications_read_at_check.name: user_notifications_read_at_check
user_notifications_read_at_check.value:
(
        "user_notifications"."status" = 'unread'
        and "user_notifications"."read_at" is null
      ) or (
        "user_notifications"."status" = 'read'
        and "user_notifications"."read_at" is not null
      )
